_about: Generic 21700 class cells for VoltTwin. Values are representative class values, NOT taken from a LiionDB entry or a named part's datasheet. LiionDB / PyBaMM parameter sets are used only for the electrochemical model (pybamm_parameter_set).

cells.name: Generic NMC 21700 4.8 Ah class
cells.source: TASK.md §2 Phase 1 seed (Round-1 values); generic NMC 21700 class, not a specific part. Geometry = 21700 standard; cp ~0.9-1.1 kJ/kgK typical for cylindrical Li-ion (assumption); C-rate and temperature limits = class assumptions.
